newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Wife of Israel's Netanyahu fears for his life.
newsitem.headline: Wife of Israel's Netanyahu fears for his life.

text.p: The wife of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said on Sunday she feared for her husband's life following reports that he had received death threats.

"I am sad and disturbed over this thing because we are a year after the terrible tragedy that happened to us," Sara Netanyahu told Israel Channel One television referring to the assassination of Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin.
Rabin was assassinated on November 4, 1995 by a religious Jew opposed to his peace policies with the Palestinians.
"It is very sad that this subject has to come up again because of some issue in our life. All I can say is that we trust our security forces. We are doing what they tell us to," she said.
Israel Television reported last month that Netanyahu and other legislators had received death threats.
Sara Netanyahu is the third wife of the twice-divorced Netanyahu. They have two sons, aged four and one.
